tweets.text:
I just wanted to say thank you to @POTUS. I am honored. I also want to extend my gratitude to @SecDef for this opportunity.

I must emphasize that I am the leader I am today because of the incredible Soldiers I served with in Afghanistan. Their bravery, dedication, courage & sacrifice have shaped me profoundly. 

I am alive today because of them.

I accept this position with great humility, recognizing that we are all standing on the shoulders of giants—those warriors who came before us, who sacrificed so much on behalf of a grateful nation.

I also want to thank my wonderful wife, Melanie, & our five incredible children for their unwavering support & love. This achievement is as much theirs as it is mine.

Time to get to work! 🇺🇸
